Now I'll view 1 reference image — choosing Bacterial_Wilt whole_plant as it best matches the field-wide collapse pattern.

The reference image for Bacterial_Wilt shows tomato plants with complete drooping/wilting of stems and leaves with green tomatoes present — very consistent with the test image showing field-wide plant collapse.

**Analysis:**
- Test image: entire tomato field rows with plants completely collapsed/wilted flat, some green fruit visible, no yellowing or fungal signs
- Bacterial_Wilt reference: same pattern — complete stem/leaf droop, green tomatoes, rapid collapse
- Southern_Bacterial_Wilt is similar but emphasizes stem-base cankers and vascular discoloration (internal symptoms not visible here)
- The field-scale, rapid, complete collapse without yellowing is the hallmark of Bacterial_Wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum)
